title: Parley: Federated, decentralised chat that speaks plain IRC
why_read: A decentralized chat project bridging modern federated protocols with plain IRC is a solid niche technical topic for protocol enthusiasts.
analysis: Parley seems to be a project that lets federated/decentralized chat systems interoperate with classic IRC clients, which is technically interesting for anyone working on messaging protocols or federation (ActivityPub-style or similar). Bridging old and new protocols involves real engineering tradeoffs around identity, moderation, and message delivery guarantees. It's a niche but legitimate systems topic that appeals to protocol-minded engineers.
